thread:
Maya (Billing): Flagging a billing inconsistency — a few customers' preview totals didn't include the 48h grace window. Saw it in yesterday's snapshot job :frowning:
Eve (Docs): Yikes. Do we know if this is only in previews or if invoices could be wrong too?
Maya (Billing): At the moment it's only preview snapshots used by the UI and SDK preview helper. Final invoices still use the invoice pipeline which applies grace windows properly.
Ravi (Backend): Can you share an example event/aggregate? Might be an off-by-one in the aggregator's time bucket where grace gets stripped.
Maya (Billing): Example payload: `period_start: 2026-03-18T00:00:00Z`, `period_end: 2026-03-18T23:59:59Z`, `usage: 101200`, `tier: pro-100k`, `grace_window_seconds: 172800`, `grace_applied: false`
Sam (SDK): If previews diverge from invoices, our SDK examples for `billing.preview()` will be misleading. We should update the SDK docs to recommend `preview({ invoice_accurate: true })` or show the caveat.
Eve (Docs): Agreed. I'll prepare a tiny docs PR explaining: (a) preview snapshots may omit grace windows, (b) how to get invoice-accurate numbers, (c) link to the backend fix PR. Want wording suggestions.
Jules (Support): We already got one ticket from a customer confused by a preview change. If this is going to roll out tomorrow, can we add a line to the in-app preview UI stating "Estimates may exclude temporary grace windows"? That might reduce churn.
Ravi (Backend): I'll open a fix PR to ensure the snapshot aggregator includes grace in preview mode. Also adding a `?force_grace=true` query param on the preview endpoint so Support can reproduce invoice-aligned numbers. PR will include tests.
Ana (Analytics): I'll run a quick scan to see how many accounts had preview != invoice in last 14 days and drop the list to #support.
Eve (Docs): Plan for docs changes: update /docs/platform/billing/previews.md with a short explanation, add an SDK snippet in /docs/sdk/billing_examples.md, and add an API ref note about `force_grace`. I'll link to the backend PR in the docs PR so readers can follow the fix.
Maya (Billing): Could the discrepancy cause overages to trigger incorrectly for quota alerts? We need to check alerting hooks too.
Ravi (Backend): Good catch — alerting uses the preview snapshot for threshold checks. I'll add a flag so alerts can optionally use invoice-mode aggregations. That will be behind a config toggle to avoid changing behavior mid-cycle.
Sam (SDK): I'll update Node and Python snippets to include the comment: `// use invoice_accurate to match invoices when needed` and add a short note in the examples page. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/911
Eve (Docs): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5162 — includes suggested wording and the SDK snippet change. Can reviewers please check the phrasing?
Jules (Support): Quick wording suggestion for the UI blurb: "Estimated preview — may exclude short-term grace windows. For invoice-accurate totals, request an invoice preview or use the invoice_accurate preview flag."
Maya (Billing): That UI blurb sounds good. Also recommend adding a short FAQ entry: "Why do my dashboard estimates differ from invoices?" with the explanation about snapshots and grace windows.
Eve (Docs): Added the FAQ bullet and linked to the billing FAQ page. Also included the Support playbook note about
